Driver later waits for child exit, closes/fsyncs/hashes process.log and writes the completion receipt. Later stage receipts rehash all earlier files under independently labelled later-stage trees. No file is rewritten.
cache_artifact_and_manifest_contract.process_a_payload_tree_definition: complete exact child-owned regular-file inventory under process_a at manifest time, excluding cache/manifest.json itself, driver-owned still-open process.log, and future completion_receipt.json; manifest and both excluded driver-owned artifacts are separately hashed by precleanup and every later stage; no other exclusion, extra, missing, symlink, partial or temporary entry

staged_non_self_referential_tree_contrac.canonical_json_algorithm: SHA256 canonical compact JSON of that stage's ordered [relative_path,sha256,logical_bytes] triples

identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.call_events: each process call_events.ndjson is append-only canonical JSON with exactly 1000 records and is fsynced before its receipt
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.progress: each process progress.ndjson is append-only canonical JSON with exactly 1002 records: one start, 1000 call_committed in exact execution order, one process_complete; each call_committed binds call-event ordinal/request/output SHA; no overwrite/truncation
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.process_log: driver creates each process.log with exclusive create before spawning that child and redirects the child's stdout and stderr to that one file for the entire child lifetime; child never opens/hashes/claims the log; after bounded wait returns, driver flushes/closes/fsyncs the log, hashes exact bytes, and never appends again
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.worker_receipt: child writes process_a/receipt.json or process_b/receipt.json before exit, binding identity, call_events, progress, outputs and worker-local checks but explicitly not binding final process.log SHA/bytes, exit code or future completion receipt
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.driver_completion_receipt: only driver writes process_a/completion_receipt.json or process_b/completion_receipt.json after the child is reaped or the frozen timeout/termination protocol finishes and after final log close/fsync/hash; receipt obeys driver_completion_receipt_exact_schema and is atomic/fsynced
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.success_completion: success requires exit_code=0, child_completed=true, worker_passed=true, worker receipt PASS and immutable final log SHA/bytes; both A and B completion receipts must exist before independent_precleanup_audit starts
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.success_lifecycle: on success, no failure_receipt.json exists anywhere; all required_relative_outputs exist exactly and B memmap is absent
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.pre_intent_failure_lifecycle: before attempt_intent.json and the official Phase-A root are atomically committed, any formal/authority/source/interpreter/path/preflight failure MUST leave the Phase-A root absent; only the launcher writes an immutable external failure receipt/log under its separate attempt registry; no Phase-A-root failure file is permitted
identity_log_progress_failure_lifecycle.post_intent_failure_lifecycle: after attempt_intent.json and the official Phase-A root are atomically committed, any spawn/identity/worker/exit/timeout failure follows the unique failed-role-directory protocol: driver completes the timeout/termination/wait protocol if a child exists, closes/fsyncs/hashes partial/process.log, writes failed completion_receipt.json inside the partial role directory using explicit null/presence fields, fsyncs all existing files and that directory, atomically promotes the whole partial role directory to the formal-defined final role path and fsyncs Phase-A root; only then driver atomically writes exactly one root failure_receipt.json binding intent, attempt nonce, final role tree and completion receipt. No later success-stage owner file is written; existing identity/log/call_events/progress are frozen without truncation or repair.
